easyPrerequisites: Juniper Order Druid doesn't have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Arid Archway by tapping it, adding six {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Juniper Order Druid by tapping it, untapping Arid Archway
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Juniper Order Druid.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
